_comment: Copy this to settings.json and fill in your own values.
settings.json is gitignored - it holds where you live and when you travel,
which is not something to publish. See src/exitscreen/settings.py.
The values below are placeholders and will not work as they are.
tpc: the OVapi TimingPointCode for YOUR platform - one platform, not a
station, and already the direction you ride. Find it at
http://v0.ovapi.nl/tpc/<code> and check the destinations look right.
walk_to_platform_min: front door to standing on the platform, including
stairs. Departures sooner than this are hidden - a train you cannot
reach is worse than no train.
shorten: destination names as the feed gives them are too long for the
column. Map them to something that fits.

weather._comment: Your town. Open-Meteo needs no key.

_comment: Optional. Remove this whole section if you have no second leg.
gtfs_route_id / board_stop_id / alight_stop_id come from the national
GTFS feed - tools/build_bus_timetable.py explains how to find them.
ride_min: measured from the feed, not guessed.
transfer_min: platform-to-platform walk where you change.
buffer_min: slack before the connection leaves. Being early is free;
missing it is not.
arrive_at_least_min: the SMALLEST acceptable margin before you must be
there. A floor, not a target - the planner takes the LATEST service
that still clears it.
weekly: start times, or null on a free day.
